# Ganessh Kumar

> Software engineer at Microsoft. I build developer tools and write practical
> notes on full-stack development, distributed systems and agentic systems.

This is the personal site of Ganessh Kumar: long-form articles, shipped
projects and notes on software engineering. Content is written by a human,
first-person, and updated over time.

## Main sections
- [Articles](https://www.ganesshkumar.com/articles/): practical engineering notes, by year.
- [Projects](https://www.ganesshkumar.com/projects/): tools, Obsidian plugins and experiments, with the problem each solves and where the code lives.
- [About](https://www.ganesshkumar.com/about/): who I am, current focus and patents.
- [Contact](https://www.ganesshkumar.com/contact/): how to reach me.

## Machine-readable
- [Sitemap](https://www.ganesshkumar.com/sitemap.xml): every indexable route.
